# CommsDock

> Solo engineering practice for telecom networks, systems architecture, and shipped software. Operated by one engineer, end-to-end — no vendor stack in between.

CommsDock is the consulting practice of a telecommunications engineer who also works as a developer and solution architect. The practice serves small-to-medium businesses and technology-led startups who want fewer vendors and more delivery.

## Practitioner

- **Discipline:** Telecommunications engineering, systems architecture, software development, AI integration.
- **Mode:** Solo operator. The person you scope with is the person who delivers.
- **Established:** 2014.
- **Footprint:** 47 networks deployed across 6 countries.
- **Base:** Australia (AEST). Remote-first, with APAC and global delivery experience.
- **Current availability:** Accepting Q2 / Q3 2026 engagements.

## What CommsDock offers

### Telecommunications engineering
RF planning, IP transport design, microwave backhaul, carrier-grade network architecture, last-mile delivery, on-site commissioning, network operations and assurance.

### Systems architecture
Cloud and hybrid-edge designs, observability and SLO design, infrastructure as code, on-call playbooks, vendor consolidation, migration planning.

### Software delivery
Application development from API to runtime, integration work, internal tooling, technical due diligence, code review and modernisation.

### AI integration
Practical LLM features inside business systems — retrieval, agentic workflows, evaluation harnesses, guardrails, cost and latency management.

## How to engage

- **Discovery call:** /contact — free 30-minute scoping conversation.
- **Engagement models:** Fractional (ongoing retainer), project (fixed scope), advisory (per-session).
- **Response latency:** Within one business day.
